# VOIDINK Studios

> Remote-first creative and technology studio for custom artwork, branding, websites, apps, and AI agents. Packages from $39 USD with full ownership on delivery. Also known as VOIDINK, Void Ink Studios, Voidink Studio, voidinkstudio, and voidinkstudios. Contact: support@voidinkstudios.com.

VOIDINK Studios serves brands, creators, startups, and streamers worldwide. We are not a tattoo studio and are not affiliated with Void Ink Tattoo Berlin, Vo Ink Studio (Moncton), or voidinkstudio.vercel.app.

Typical snapshot: 15 services, 500+ projects, 200+ clients in 25 countries, ~99% satisfaction. Work starts after a free consultation and 50% deposit; remaining 50% is due before final file delivery. NDAs available; portfolio display only with client permission.
